sections.title: Movers in Westwood, Planned Around Your Building
sections.content: Hiring a moving company in Westwood means planning for the building as much as the boxes. An apartment in the North Village, a condo tower on Wilshire Boulevard and a house in Westwood Hills each bring different access, parking and paperwork. SOS Moving sends crews from our Los Angeles headquarters with two movers and a truck from $119/hr Monday–Thursday (cash rate) or $135/hr Friday–Sunday. The basics before you book: Licensed and insured: CPUC licensed (CAL-T0192140), registered under USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, with full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Reviewed on two platforms: Rated 4.9 on Google from 1,007 reviews. Straightforward billing: Hourly billing plus a $30 gas fee, and the $50 deposit counts toward your total. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are included in the hourly rate. Call 909-443-0004 any day from 8AM to 6PM, or request a free estimate online.

sections.title: Packing Services for Westwood Condos and Apartments
sections.content: Condo towers along the Wilshire Corridor commonly schedule moves into a reserved elevator window, so every box should be packed and sealed before the crew walks in. Our packing services take care of that ahead of move day, whether it's a Wilshire condo, a North Village apartment or a house in Westwood Hills. How we pack a Westwood home: Materials on the truck: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and wardrobe boxes are included on moves around Los Angeles, so hanging clothes go straight from the closet into a box. Art and fragile pieces: Framed art, mirrors and glassware are wrapped one piece at a time. For antiques and high-value items, ask about our white glove movers. Summer storage: UCLA's on-campus housing contracts end in June and fall move-in comes in mid-September. If you need somewhere to keep your things in between, we can pack them up and hold them in storage. Want packing added to your move? Mention it when you request your estimate.

sections.title: Westwood Local Movers for Apartments, Condos and Houses
sections.content: These crews handle moves that stay within Los Angeles; for a new address in another state or at the far end of California, our long-distance movers take over. As Westwood residential movers, we plan around tight curbs: many streets around Westwood Village are in preferential parking districts, so we settle where the truck will stand before move day. Westwood moves we plan for: North Village apartments: The blocks west of Gayley, north of Weyburn and east of Veteran are mostly apartments where many UCLA students live. Our apartment movers can drop roommates' furniture at separate addresses, since multiple stops are part of the hourly rate. Wilshire Corridor condos: Towers between Comstock Avenue and I-405 generally require a certificate of insurance and a reserved elevator before movers start. Send us the management office's requirements and we'll get the COI to them ahead of your date. Westwood Hills and Little Holmby houses: Furniture disassembly and reassembly, TV unmounting and placement are included. A piano adds $200, and any single item over 300 lbs adds $150. Stairs and long carries stay within the hourly rate, and same-day moves are possible when a crew is free.

sections.title: Westwood Long Distance Movers
sections.content: Leaving Westwood for another state or the far end of California? Our long-distance crews load at your door, then head north on I-405 through the Sepulveda Pass toward I-5, or south to the I-10 interchange for routes east. Staying on the Westside? A local move is the better fit, and the same dispatch handles both it and the long-distance runs. Built into a long-distance move from Westwood: Federal authority: Moves across state lines run under USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, backed by full liability coverage. Packed before pickup: Our packers can box the condo or house before the truck is loaded, so nothing rides loose on the highway. Storage between addresses: If your new place isn't ready when you leave Westwood, your belongings can wait in storage until delivery. Share your destination and a rough inventory for a free long-distance estimate.

sections.title: Westwood Commercial Movers
sections.content: Relocating a storefront in Westwood Village or an office in one of the Wilshire towers near I-405? Our commercial movers pack and move desks, files and equipment, and can schedule the job on a Saturday or Sunday.

faq.question: Do Wilshire Corridor condo buildings require a certificate of insurance?
faq.answer: Condo towers along the Wilshire Corridor typically require one before a crew can start, along with a reserved freight or service elevator. Send us your building's move-in requirements when you book and we'll send the certificate to management. Reserve the elevator with your building, then share the time window so the crew arrives ready to load.

faq.question: When do moves around UCLA get busiest?
faq.answer: Demand around campus follows the UCLA housing calendar: on-campus move-in happens in mid-September, and spring housing contracts end in June. If your date falls near either, book as early as you can. Same-day moves are possible when a crew is free, but that's harder to count on at those times of year.

faq.question: Where will the moving truck park in Westwood?
faq.answer: Many residential streets around Westwood Village are in preferential parking districts with posted time limits, so open curb space is hard to count on. When you book, tell us about your driveway, loading dock or garage entrance, and we'll plan where the truck stops. In a condo or apartment building, ask management which entrance movers should use.

faq.question: What does an hour of crew time cost for a Westwood apartment move?
faq.answer: Two movers and a truck start at $119/hr Monday–Thursday (cash rate) and $135/hr Friday–Sunday, plus a $30 gas fee; the $50 deposit is applied toward your total. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are included, while a piano adds $200 and items over 300 lbs add $150. On longer hourly moves, Double Drive Time applies under CPUC rules.

faq.question: Can you store a UCLA student's things over the summer?
faq.answer: Yes. If you're leaving a Westwood apartment in June and your fall lease hasn't started, we can move your furniture and boxes into storage and deliver them to the new address. Add packing if you'd rather not box everything yourself.
